selected_skill.selection_reason: High-star payment-adjacent skill with a folder-scan, invoice extraction, renaming, and organization workflow that maps well to accounts-payable batch preparation.

safe_use_screening.notes: The template uses public sample invoices, task-local reference files, and a local review service. It avoids outside payment accounts, merchant credentials, live charges, and webhook secrets.

real_data_design.source_type: public invoice samples plus task-local payment review facts
real_data_design.normalization_strategy: Use public sample documents as the semantic backbone for vendor names, invoice numbers, dates, currencies, and amounts, then layer task-local vendor aliases, expense categories, duplicate policy, and AP review states on top.
real_data_design.determinism: All task inputs and review-service payloads live inside the template, so the verifier can recompute expected outputs without network calls.

services: local ap review service on 127.0.0.1:8148 with manifest, paginated document inventory, and per-document current review facts
environment_design.with_without_control: with_skill and without_skill differ only by whether environment/skills is present in the runtime copy and copied into the agent skill path.

goals: State the batch deliverables, current-source rule, and file-organization contract clearly.
Keep the batch workflow explicit while leaving folder scan, extraction order, and duplicate handling steps mostly implicit.
Make the stale settlement snapshot tempting but insufficient.
hidden_workflow_pressure: The document inventory is paginated and includes live-only records that are absent from the stale snapshot.
Current payment status and manual-review flags only come from the AP review service.
The verifier checks both service traversal and document-copy behavior.

main_tests: required output files exist and parse
invoice register rows exactly match document-derived fields plus policy and live review facts
payment batch JSON recomputes payable rows, exclusion reasons, currency totals, and service checks
batch review note contains the required operational facts
guardrails: solver must query the manifest endpoint and traverse all document pages before verifier traffic
solver must fetch detail facts for every live document
input files, hidden service files, and installed skill files must remain unchanged
organized output copies must exist for every row and preserve source file hashes
service must remain healthy at verifier end
live-only documents absent from the stale snapshot must still appear in the output
verifier_design.failure_target: without_skill should fail for action-level reasons such as trusting the stale snapshot, skipping later pages, skipping detail fetches, or mishandling folder-wide organization and duplicate review.

experiment_protocol.isolation_rule: Every cloud trial must use a new isolated runtime copy.
experiment_protocol.oracle_rule: Do not finalize README until oracle and comparison trials are available.
experiment_protocol.comparison_rule: with_skill and without_skill differ only by environment/skills presence and corresponding copy behavior.
